description: This file defines the class 'kaitenrestInterface', an implementation of an issue tracker interface for Kaiten within the TestLink project. It includes methods for connecting to the Kaiten API, retrieving issues, creating issues, adding notes, and configuration handling.

classes.name: kaitenrestInterface
classes.description: Implements the issue tracker interface for Kaiten, providing methods to connect to Kaiten's API, retrieve, create, and comment on issues, and handle configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Kaiten API connection based on configuration parameters.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes and normalizes configuration parameters such as URL base and options.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the Kaiten API client instance.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks whether an issue ID has the correct syntax.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to Kaiten API and verifies connectivity.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns true if connected to Kaiten API.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Builds and returns the URL to view a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches issue details from Kaiten based on issue ID.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns the verbose status string of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns the HTML string of an issue's summary.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if an issue exists on Kaiten.

methods.name: parseAddInfo
methods.description: Parses additional info text to extract description and links.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Kaiten with given summary and info.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment/note to an existing issue.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Returns an XML template for configuring the Kaiten issue tracker.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether issues can be created via API (returns true).
